# MyCalAgent — AI Wellness Intelligence Platform
# llms.txt — structured site manifest for AI agents, LLMs, and answer engines
# Standard: https://llmstxt.org
# Last updated: 2026-05-24

> MyCalAgent is an AI-powered wellness intelligence platform available on iOS and Android.
> It helps users understand how meals, hydration, fasting windows, and daily habits affect how they feel —
> using AI pattern recognition to surface personalized insights beyond basic calorie counting.
> Privacy-first. No ads. GDPR compliant.

## About MyCalAgent

- **Product:** MyCalAgent — AI Wellness Intelligence App
- **Category:** Health & Fitness (iOS / Android)
- **Developer:** MyCalAgent Inc.
- **Website:** https://www.mycalagent.com
- **App Store (iOS):** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mycalagent/id6759270828
- **Google Play (Android):** https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mycalagent.app
- **Pricing:** Free plan available. Pro plan from $6.99/month or $69.99/year.
- **Contact:** support@mycalagent.com

## Core Capabilities

1. **AI Meal Photo Analysis** — Snap a photo of any meal; AI identifies every ingredient, estimates portions, and returns a full nutrition breakdown (calories, protein, carbs, fat) in under 6 seconds.
2. **Wellness Pattern Recognition** — AI correlates meals, hydration, caffeine, fasting, and habits over time to detect patterns affecting energy, mood, and focus.
3. **Food & Mood Insights** — Surfaces connections between what you eat and how you feel throughout the day.
4. **Intermittent Fasting Tracker** — Tracks fasting windows with AI analysis of how fasting patterns interact with energy and nutrition data.
5. **Hydration Tracking** — Logs daily water intake; AI connects hydration levels to energy and cognitive performance.
6. **Apple Health Integration** — Syncs activity, sleep, and health metrics for a complete wellness picture.
7. **Free Macro & Calorie Calculator** — Evidence-based tool using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is MyCalAgent?**
MyCalAgent is an AI wellness intelligence platform for iOS and Android that helps users understand how their meals, hydration, fasting, and habits affect how they feel — using pattern recognition AI rather than just calorie counting.

**How does AI meal analysis work?**
Take a photo of any meal. MyCalAgent's AI identifies ingredients, estimates portions, and returns a complete nutrition breakdown (calories, protein, carbs, fat) in under 6 seconds. No barcodes or manual entry required.

**Is MyCalAgent free?**
Yes — a free plan is available. The Pro plan ($6.99/month or $69.99/year) unlocks full AI pattern insights, unlimited meal analysis, and advanced wellness tracking.

**Is MyCalAgent a medical app?**
No. MyCalAgent is designed for wellness awareness and general nutrition tracking. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Always consult a healthcare professional for medical decisions.

**What formula does the macro calculator use?**
The Mifflin-St Jeor equation (1990) — the most widely validated formula for estimating Basal Metabolic Rate in adults. Source: Mifflin MD et al., Am J Clin Nutr, 51(2):241-247.

**Does MyCalAgent work with Apple Health?**
Yes. MyCalAgent integrates with Apple Health to sync activity, sleep, and health metrics alongside nutrition data.
